dedupe_keys.name: conatel venezuela quarterly telecommunications sector statistics internet fixed mobile subscription tv 2018 to 2025

description: CONATEL, the telecommunications regulator of Venezuela, publishes quarterly presentations of sector figures (Cifras del sector de telecomunicaciones). There are separate pages for internet, fixed telephony, subscription broadcasting and .ve domain names, and a sector page with overall figures for the fourth quarters of 2018 and 2019. The internet page lists 12 quarterly files from the first quarter of 2023 to the fourth quarter of 2025, and the latest file of 13 pages reports internet subscribers by access type, including dedicated and standard mobile broadband as defined by the ITU, and fixed broadband. Operators include CANTV, Movilnet, Movistar and Digitel. Coverage: Venezuela, national totals by quarter and access type. Format and access: PDF presentations on the CONATEL website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: a gap between 2020 and 2022 on the pages read; figures are official and could not be checked against operator reports; PDF only. Simulation uses: quarterly subscriber series for Venezuelan telecom demand models and for studies of network decline during the electricity blackouts of 2019. Related records: data-itu-ict-statistics gives annual series; data-ookla-open-data-performance-tiles gives measured speeds in Venezuela.
licence: not stated (no licence or terms statement on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
